headline: Copper Prices Surpass $12,300 Per Tonne on Risk Appetite Recovery
summary: Copper prices rose up to 4.4% to exceed $12,300 per tonne on global risk appetite recovery and low inventories in China.
why: Copper is a vital industrial metal whose price movements signal shifts in global manufacturing demand and economic activity.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Reflects spot commodity price increases for copper futures.
